description:
Lies of P Complete Edition - SHOULD You PLAY It? Is it WORTH It?
In this video, we're going to be returning to one of my personal favorite soulslikes, Lies of P. I've been in the know about this game for around 4 years now, having played the test demo way back at Gamescom 2022, reviewing the game in 2023, and then the DLC in 2025. Ever since I got my hands on that first demo, I knew it was going to be a hit, and it's amazing to see just how far this Belle Epoque Soulslike has come. And now, to make things even better, Lies of P: Complete Edition launched on Nintendo Switch 2. So whether you're a first-time player or a returning puppet-slayer, there's never been a better time to jump back in.

Get the Game HERE: https://www.liesofp.com/?utm_source=fextralife&utm_medium=influencer&utm_campaign=lop_ns2_gameinfluencer
